description: Temporal GAT - clinical spatial + temporal past-to-current edges

edge_types.clinical: (f_i, t) -> (f_j, t) for each valid t, from edges.csv
edge_types.temporal: (f, t-1) -> (f, t) for consecutive valid t ONLY
edge_types.self_loop: (f, t) -> (f, t) for each valid node

anti_leakage: enforced: all temporal edges have source_t < dest_t
gru: NOT USED in GAT-2 (temporal dynamics handled by graph edges)
pooling: learned feature-attention pooling over 35 nodes per timestep
